scope: Frozen first structural pilot; post-evaluation inspection, no retraining or test selection

optical_audit.protocol: All actually used validation units when --units=0, otherwise a fixed prefix; original frozen decoder must reproduce production roofs before perturbation; no model or threshold selection
optical_audit.limits: A validation diagnostic, not an independent test-set causal estimate or accuracy comparison. No reference roof or paired GT index is opened; only frozen training IDs and prediction inventory metadata are used.

relative_metric_note: Uncapped relative-gradient MAE and capped missing-data loss answer different questions; both remain in evaluation downloads. No certified absolute height claims.

test_bootstrap.resampling: Resample frozen source/split groups with replacement; apply identical group draws to all methods; sum matched and total lengths before computing F1.
limits: Descriptive within-dataset group-resampling intervals; not a national or unseen-city uncertainty estimate.
Does not account for official reference errors, epoch differences or misspecified supervision.
The same held-out sample is described; no hyperparameters or checkpoints are changed.

inspection_details.shared_eligibility: All four methods have roofs, reference roof area >=25m2; at most one unit per frozen split group in each list.
inspection_details.boundary_improvement_rule: Reference structural boundary >=5m; rank positive per-unit B minus A boundary F1@1m descending, tie by block/id.
inspection_details.gradient_degradation_rule: At least30 reference neighbor pairs; all four methods cover every fixed reference pair; rank positive uncapped B minus raw relative-gradient MAE descending, tie by block/id.
inspection_details.limits: Post-evaluation examples selected to inspect observed strengths and failures; not representative average performance and never used for tuning.
